releases.name: Release v2.0.0
releases.body:
This is the first update to bring this mod into a playable state, also adding some extra content on the side.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed a multitude of bugs in the end sequence
- Fixed a bug where a greedy guy wouldn't accept a bush
- Fixed a bug where a bush wouldn't stay put
- Fixed a bug with certain objects not appearing in a door
- Removed unnecessary scroll walls that were misleading
- Fixed a bug with audio being too loud
- Renamed all of the ship log IDs and dialogue conditions to start with `BT_`
  - Incompatible with previous versions of the mod

### Performance / QOL
- Added LOD to the rest of the trees
- Added more to the ship log for guidance
- Added physical ship log locations
- Made it less annoying to die in a worship area

### Content
- Added a planet icon to the ship log
- Added more dialogue including hidden dialogue
- Improved a certain logic puzzle
- Reworked the layout of a certain worship area
- Added a couple short music tracks
- Added a Nomai scroll
- Added a secret Ernesto
